title: The Guardian's Assessment and the Breaking Point
summary: On Thursday, March 5, 2015, court-appointed Guardian ad Litem Ms. Anya Sharma visits CPI, interviewing Dr. Alistair, inspecting Suite 214/216, and reviewing Jordan's independent medical, tax, and academic dossier. That afternoon at the Blacksburg Cardiac Rehabilitation Center, the emotional weight of the week collides with physical exertion as Jordan pushes through the Breaking Point.
